originalDsl:
@diagram uml-sequence
Client actor as "Client"
Coordinator participant as "Transaction Coordinator"
OrderService participant as "Order Service"
InventoryService participant as "Inventory Service"
PaymentService participant as "Payment Service"
OrderDB participant as "Order Database"
InventoryDB participant as "Inventory Database"
PaymentDB participant as "Payment Database"

msg_1 = Client -#> Coordinator as "begin transaction"
msg_2 = Coordinator -#> OrderService as "prepare(order)"
msg_3 = OrderService -#> OrderDB as "write pending order"
msg_4 = OrderDB -.-> OrderService as "write ok"
msg_5 = OrderService -.-> Coordinator as "vote commit"
msg_6 = Coordinator -#> InventoryService as "prepare(reserve stock)"
msg_7 = InventoryService -#> InventoryDB as "write pending reservation"
msg_8 = InventoryDB -.-> InventoryService as "write ok"
msg_9 = InventoryService -.-> Coordinator as "vote commit"
msg_10 = Coordinator -#> PaymentService as "prepare(charge)"
msg_11 = PaymentService -#> PaymentDB as "write pending charge"
msg_12 = PaymentDB -.-> PaymentService as "write ok"
msg_13 = PaymentService -.-> Coordinator as "vote commit"
msg_14 = Coordinator -#> OrderService as "commit"
msg_15 = Coordinator -#> InventoryService as "commit"
msg_16 = Coordinator -#> PaymentService as "commit"
msg_17 = Coordinator -.-> Client as "transaction committed"

injectedDefects.description: replaced closing quote on label "Transaction Coordinator" with Unicode look-alike U+201D
